name: Ring of Scholastic Focus
body:
Price 5,000 gp; Aura faint evocation; CL 5; Weight –

This ring consists of a band of twisted gold and silver and set with multicolored gems, one for each school of magic.

This ring allows the wearer to cast dancing lights at will.

If the wearer has the Spell Focus feat, they gain a +2 bonus on any checks related to identifying spells of the same school. Additionally, they gain a +4 bonus to any caster level or skill checks related to the written form of such spells.

If the wearer has 3 or more instances of the Spell Focus feat, they also gain a +1 bonus to saves against spells of the schools chosen for those feats.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 2,500 gp; Feats Forge Ring, Spell Focus; Spells dancing lights
